description: Update the expiry of one of the USER'S OWN listings (renew it): the listing runs for another 30 days from now (native listings lapse ~30 days after posting). Use it when the user wants to keep an ad running ("extend my listing", "my ad expired, put it back") or when list_my_listings shows it as expired. Renewing an expired listing returns it to active. Do not use it on a pending, rejected, sold or draft listing — the call fails: a pending one only needs moderation to finish, a rejected one needs its content changed with update_listing, and a sold one is closed. Free — no credit charge. Returns { success, listing } with the renewed listing.

listing_id.description: Listing id, taken from the `id` field of search_listings, semantic_search or list_my_listings results. Example: "adzuna-us-5947308680".

name: renew_listing
